headline: Foreign hot money inflows push NT dollar up for a 4th straight day! Central bank analyzes outlook for yen and won - Liberty Financial
summary: Taiwan stocks reached a new record high, led by TSMC, with the benchmark index approaching 50,000 points. The NT dollar strengthened past the 31.8 level against the US dollar as foreign hot money flowed in.
why: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker, so its share price strongly influences Taiwan's benchmark index and global semiconductor supply chains.
why_moved: Foreign hot money inflows lifted Taiwan equities to a record and strengthened the NT dollar, per the report.
